description: Every Browserbase cloud feature, plus session lifecycle control, local history, and usage analytics no other tool has.

tools.name: agents_create
tools.description: Create a reusable agent. An agent defines a `systemPrompt` and `resultSchema` that guide its behavior for every run. Only `name` is required; an agent created with no `systemPrompt` behaves like an unconfigured run. Required: name. Optional: resultSchema, systemPrompt. Returns the new Agent.

params.name: name
params.description: Human-readable name for the agent. Used to identify the agent in the dashboard and API responses.

params.name: resultSchema
params.description: An optional [JSON Schema](https://json-schema.org/specification) object. If provided, runs that reference this agent will aim to return a `result` that conforms to this schema when they complete. Can be overridden per run by passing `resultSchema` on the run request.

params.name: systemPrompt
params.description: System prompt that steers the agent's behavior on every run that uses this agent.

tools.name: agents_delete
tools.description: Delete an agent. Runs that already referenced this agent are unaffected. Required: agentId. Destructive.

tools.name: agents_get
tools.description: Retrieve an agent by ID. Required: agentId. Returns the Agent.

tools.name: agents_list
tools.description: List agents across your account. Supports filtering by creation time. Optional: startAt, endAt, limit (default: 20) (plus 1 more). Returns array of Agent.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Only return agents created on or after this timestamp (inclusive). ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

params.name: endAt
params.description: Only return agents created on or before this timestamp (inclusive). ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to start from the first page.

tools.name: agents_runs-create
tools.description: Run a browser agent to complete the `task` by using web search and browser tooling. Optionally pass `agentId` to run a [custom agent](/reference/api/create-an-agent) you've created. Required: task. Optional: agentId, browserSettings, resultSchema (plus 1 more). Returns the new AgentRun.

params.name: agentId
params.description: Optionally run a specific [custom agent](/reference/api/create-an-agent) you've created by ID. The run will use the agent's `systemPrompt` and `resultSchema` unless overridden.

params.name: browser-settings-context-persist
params.description: Whether to persist the context after browsing. Defaults to false.

params.name: browser-settings-proxies
params.description: Proxy configuration. Can be true for default proxy, or an array of proxy configurations.

params.name: browser-settings-verified
params.description: Set true to enable Browserbase Verified for the session.

params.name: resultSchema
params.description: An optional [JSON Schema](https://json-schema.org/specification) object. If provided, the agent will aim to return a `result` that conforms to this schema when the run completes. Overrides the referenced agent's default `resultSchema` for this run only.

params.name: task
params.description: A natural language description of the task the agent should accomplish.

params.name: variables
params.description: Optional named variables the agent can reference as placeholders, i.e. `%variable%`. Each entry pairs a `value` the placeholder resolves to with an optional `description` that hints to the agent when it should be used. Values are not persisted.

tools.name: agents_runs-get
tools.description: Retrieve the current status and details of a run, including its result and associated session information. To fetch the run's messages, use [List Run Messages](/reference/api/list-run-messages). Required: runId. Returns the AgentRun.

tools.name: agents_runs-list
tools.description: List runs across your account. Supports filtering by status, by the agent they reference, and by creation time. Optional: status, agentId, startAt (plus 3 more). Returns array of AgentRun.

params.name: status
params.description: Current status of the run. - `PENDING` - agent will run soon - `RUNNING` - agent is currently running - `COMPLETED` - agent has finished running - `FAILED` - agent has failed the run - `STOPPED` - run was stopped by the user - `TIMED_OUT` - run exceeded maximum time

params.name: agentId
params.description: Only return runs that reference this agent ID.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Only return runs created on or after this timestamp (inclusive). ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

params.name: endAt
params.description: Only return runs created on or before this timestamp (inclusive). ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to start from the first page.

tools.name: agents_runs-messages
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of messages produced by a run, in chronological order, with the oldest messages first. Messages conform to the [AI SDK UIMessage format](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/ui-message). Required: runId. Optional: since, limit (default: 20), all (default: false).

params.name: since
params.description: The `id` of the last message you've already received. The response will contain messages produced after that one, in chronological order. Omit on the first call. Pass the previous response's `nextSince` value to continue paging or to poll for new messages.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

params.name: all
params.description: Return every message after `since` in one response, ignoring `limit`.

tools.name: agents_runs-stop
tools.description: Request that an in-progress run stop. The run winds down and transitions to `STOPPED`. Stopping a run that has already finished returns a conflict. Required: runId.

tools.name: agents_update
tools.description: Update an existing agent. Only the fields provided in the body are modified; omitted fields are left unchanged. Required: agentId. Optional: name, resultSchema, systemPrompt. Returns the updated Agent.

params.name: name
params.description: Human-readable name for the agent. Used to identify the agent in the dashboard and API responses.

params.name: resultSchema
params.description: An optional [JSON Schema](https://json-schema.org/specification) object. If provided, runs that reference this agent will aim to return a `result` that conforms to this schema when they complete. Can be overridden per run by passing `resultSchema` on the run request.

params.name: systemPrompt
params.description: New system prompt that steers the agent's behavior on every run that uses this agent.

tools.name: certificates_delete

tools.name: certificates_get

tools.name: certificates_list
tools.description: List Certificates. Returns array of Certificate.

tools.name: certificates_upload

tools.name: contexts_create
tools.description: Create a Context. Optional: name, projectId. Returns the new ContextsCreateResponse.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional user-defined name for the Context. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before storage. Names are unique within the project among active Contexts, compared case-insensitively.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The Project ID. Can be found in [Settings](https://www.browserbase.com/settings). Optional - if not provided, the project will be inferred from the API key.

tools.name: contexts_delete
tools.description: Delete a Context. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: contexts_get
tools.description: Get a Context. Required: id. Returns the Context.

tools.name: downloads_delete
tools.description: Delete a download file from storage and mark as deleted. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: downloads_get
tools.description: Get download metadata (Accept: application/json) or file content (Accept: application/octet-stream). Required: id. Returns the DownloadsGetResponse.

tools.name: downloads_list
tools.description: List all downloads for a session with optional filtering and pagination. Required: sessionId. Optional: filename, mimeType, minSize (plus 5 more). Returns array of DownloadsListItem.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Filter downloads created on or after this timestamp.

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Filter downloads created on or before this timestamp.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

tools.name: extensions_delete
tools.description: Delete an Extension. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: extensions_get
tools.description: Get an Extension. Required: id. Returns the Extension.

tools.name: extensions_upload
tools.description: Upload an Extension. Required: file. Returns the new Extension.

tools.name: fetch_create
tools.description: Fetch a page and return its content, headers, and metadata. Required: url. Optional: allowInsecureSsl (default: false), allowRedirects (default: false), format (default: raw) (plus 2 more). Returns the new FetchCreateResponse.

params.name: allowInsecureSsl
params.description: Whether to bypass TLS certificate verification

params.name: format
params.description: Output format for the response content. `raw` (default) returns the response body unchanged; `json` returns structured data (requires `schema`); `markdown` returns the page as markdown.

params.name: proxies
params.description: Whether to enable proxy support for the request

params.name: schema
params.description: JSON Schema describing the desired structure of the response. Only used when `format` is `json`.

tools.name: functions_builds-get
tools.description: Get a Function Build. Required: id. Returns array of FunctionsBuildsGetItem.

tools.name: functions_builds-get-logs
tools.description: Get Function Build Logs. Required: id. Returns array of FunctionBuildLog.

tools.name: functions_builds-list
tools.description: List Function Builds. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20), status. Returns array of FunctionBuild.

tools.name: functions_get

tools.name: functions_invocations-get
tools.description: Get an Invocation. Required: id. Returns the FunctionsInvocationsGetResponse.

tools.name: functions_invocations-get-logs
tools.description: Get Invocation Logs. Required: id. Returns array of InvocationLog.

tools.name: functions_list
tools.description: List Functions. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20). Returns array of Function.

tools.name: functions_versions-get
tools.description: Get a Function Version. Required: id. Returns the FunctionVersion.

tools.name: functions_versions-list-invocations
tools.description: List Invocations for a Function Version. Required: id. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20), status. Returns array of Invocation.

tools.name: functions_invoke_functions
tools.description: Invoke a Function. Required: id. Returns the new Invocation.

tools.name: functions_versions_functions-list
tools.description: List Function Versions. Required: id. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20). Returns array of FunctionVersion.

tools.name: projects_get
tools.description: Get a Project. Required: id. Returns the Project.

tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List Projects. Returns array of Project.

tools.name: projects_usage_projects
tools.description: Get Project Usage. Required: id. Returns the ProjectUsage.

tools.name: sessions_create
tools.description: Create a Session. Optional: browserSettings, extensionId, keepAlive (plus 6 more). Returns the new SessionsCreateResponse.

params.name: browser-settings-allowed-domains
params.description: An optional list of allowed domains for the session. If you pass one or more domains, Browserbase restricts top-level (main-frame) page navigations to the listed domains and their subdomains. For example, `example.com` also permits `www.example.com` and `a.b.example.com`, but not `notexample.com`. Matching is domain-based, not full-URL. An empty list (the default) disables the restriction entirely. Browserbase enforces only main-frame navigations; it does not block iframe/subframe loads or other in-page resource requests (images, scripts, XHR, etc.).

params.name: browser-settings-block-ads
params.description: Enable or disable ad blocking in the browser. Defaults to `false`.

params.name: browser-settings-captcha-image-selector
params.description: Custom selector for captcha image. See [Custom Captcha Solving](/features/stealth-mode#custom-captcha-solving)

params.name: browser-settings-captcha-input-selector
params.description: Custom selector for captcha input. See [Custom Captcha Solving](/features/stealth-mode#custom-captcha-solving)

params.name: browser-settings-context-persist
params.description: Whether or not to persist the context after browsing. Defaults to `false`.

params.name: browser-settings-ignore-certificate-errors
params.description: Enable or disable ignoring of certificate errors in the browser. Defaults to `true`.

params.name: browser-settings-log-session
params.description: Enable or disable session logging. Defaults to `true`.

params.name: browser-settings-os
params.description: Operating system for stealth mode. Valid values: windows, mac, linux, mobile, tablet

params.name: browser-settings-record-session
params.description: Enable or disable session recording. Defaults to `true`.

params.name: browser-settings-solve-captchas
params.description: Enable or disable captcha solving in the browser. Defaults to `true`.

params.name: keepAlive
params.description: Set to true to keep the session alive even after disconnections. Available on the Hobby Plan and above.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The Project ID. Can be found in [Settings](https://www.browserbase.com/settings). Optional - if not provided, the project will be inferred from the API key.

params.name: proxies
params.description: Proxy configuration. Can be true for default proxy, or an array of proxy configurations.

params.name: proxy-settings-ca-certificates
params.description: The TLS certificate IDs to trust. Optional.

params.name: region
params.description: The region where the Session should run.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Duration in seconds after which the session will automatically end. Defaults to the Project's `defaultTimeout`.

params.name: userMetadata
params.description: Arbitrary user metadata to attach to the session. To learn more about user metadata, see [User Metadata](/features/sessions#user-metadata).

tools.name: sessions_get
tools.description: Get a Session. Required: id. Returns the SessionsGetResponse.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List Sessions. Optional: status, q. Returns array of Session.

params.name: q
params.description: Query sessions by user metadata (e.g. `{'buildId':'123'}`). See [Querying Sessions by User Metadata](/features/sessions#querying-sessions-by-user-metadata) for the schema of this query.

tools.name: sessions_update
tools.description: Update a Session. Required: id, status. Returns the new Session.

params.name: status
params.description: Set to `REQUEST_RELEASE` to request that the session complete. Use before session's timeout to avoid additional charges.

tools.name: sessions_debug_sessions-get
tools.description: Session Live URLs. Required: id. Returns array of DebugSessionsGetItem.

tools.name: sessions_logs_sessions-get
tools.description: Session Logs. Required: id. Returns array of SessionLog.

tools.name: sessions_recording_sessions-create-downloads
tools.description: Requests one downloadable MP4 per recorded page of a session. Assembly runs asynchronously and every page returns as `PENDING`. Re-posting re-enqueues all pages and retries any that failed. Poll the GET endpoint for per-page status and, on standard (non-BYOS) projects, download URLs. Required: id.

tools.name: sessions_recording_sessions-get
tools.description: Session Recording. Required: id. Returns array of SessionRecording.

tools.name: sessions_recording_sessions-list-downloads
tools.description: Returns the per-page download status for a session, with a short-lived signed URL for each completed page on standard (non-BYOS) projects. Required: id.

tools.name: sessions_replays_sessions-get
tools.description: Returns page metadata for a session replay, including timing information and the URL of each page's HLS playlist. Required: id.

tools.name: sessions_replays_sessions-get-page
tools.description: Returns an HLS VOD media playlist (.m3u8) for a specific page of a session replay. Required: id, pageId.

tools.name: sessions_uploads_sessions-file
tools.description: Create Session Uploads. Required: id, file. Returns the new UploadsSessionsFileResponse.

tools.name: websearch_search-web
tools.description: Perform a web search and return structured results. Required: query. Optional: numResults (default: 10). Returns array of WebsearchSearchWebItem.
